invariants.rationale: The method returns an Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> only when bucketType is INSERT or UPDATE, and both handleInsert and handleUpdate are expected to return non-null Iterators.
partition is used as an argument and dereferenced in the method, particularly in getBucketInfo(partition) and error messages, implying it cannot be null at method exit.
partitioner is cast to JavaUpsertPartitioner and used to call getBucketInfo(partition); it must not be null for this method to reach its exit safely.
recordItr is passed to handleInsert or handleUpdate without null checks, so it is expected to be non-null if the method returns normally.
instantTime is used in context for upserts (though not directly in the body), and it is typical for commit operations to require a non-null instant identifier.
